input.task: Which product in the catalogue has the lowest price?

provenance: Cold review of M42, finding 2 (HIGH). `finalize` reads the ranking declaration off the FIRST `extract_all` in the trace that is not superseded — and nothing in loop mode ever sets `superseded_by`, because that pointer is written only by mode B's family-2 replan. So a first attempt that omitted `rank` (which `execute` refuses, in a message that teaches the model the exact retry — the single likeliest loop trace there is) left `enumerated = None`, `verifier.rank` never ran, and the raw unranked candidate list was returned as the answer to a which-one question with verdict PASS. Every guard that should have caught it looks at a different set: the answer-assembly `plan_gap` filters failures out and sees one clean enumeration, and `aggregate_needs_comparison` uses `any(... rank is True ...)` which the SECOND step satisfies. This is verbatim the defect family ADR-018 and PR #29 R2/R9/R16 exist to close, reopened through a code path none of those guards cover.
